name: Acquainted
source:
Grappling with the usual challenges of daily college life was supposed to be hard at times, but fun. At least that's what Lewis thought... That is, until his girlfriend broke up with him and his clingy roommate joined the same college as him while he's still trying to rebound and recover from the breakup. Handling all of those things and keeping up with classes might've been possible, but that changed when a mysterious girl from his dreams appeared.

[From Patreon]
translation:
应对日常大学生活中常见的挑战有时会很困难，但很有趣。至少刘易斯是这么想的……也就是说，直到他的女朋友与他分手，而他粘人的室友加入了与他同一所大学，而他仍在努力从分手中恢复过来。处理所有这些事情并跟上课程也许是可能的，但当他梦中的一个神秘女孩出现时，一切都改变了。

[来自帕特伦]
